_comment: Sample file. Declare sites requiring login here instead of writing a .py file per site. Each key is a site_id and AuthManager loads this file on auto_register(). Common fields: domains, login_url, check_url, username_field, password_field, extra_form (dict sent along in the login body), csrf (bool, true auto-detects input _token/_csrf...), verify_ssl (bool, default true), type (form|json|basic, default form). For type=json: token_path + token_header + token_prefix (single token) OR token_headers (dict header_name -> dotted path in the response) for sites needing several auth headers. extra_headers sets static headers on every request. If a site needs special logic, still create a .py file under core/auth/sites/ (it takes precedence over config).
